title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are looking for a high-performing Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in both Python (backend) and React (frontend) to join our client’s distributed engineering team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building clean, scalable APIs and intuitive user interfaces while collaborating with product, design, and engineering stakeholders.


You will be responsible for developing end-to-end features, improving system architecture, and supporting the evolution of a modern tech stack powering mission-critical applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Python (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • Develop responsive, user-friendly front-end applications using React, Typescript, and modern UI frameworks.
  • Implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs and integrate them with internal and external systems.
  • Work closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to translate requirements into high-quality code.
  • Optimize performance across front-end and back-end components.
  • Manage databases and data models (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Write automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end) to maintain code quality.
  • Collaborate in an agile environment with remote teams across Brazil.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer or Software Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and popular backend frameworks (FastAPI preferred, Flask, Django).
  • Professional experience with React and Typescript (Hooks, Context, Redux, or similar).
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs or GraphQL services.
  • Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Experience deploying applications using cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure ).
  • Solid grasp of software architecture, design patterns, and version control (Git).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
  • Exposure to microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (PyTest, Jest, Cypress, etc.).
  • Experience working with Brazilian or international distributed engineering teams.

title: Senior Data Scientist / ML Engineer
description:
Project Description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.

Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.

Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.


Responsibilities:

  • We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with Machine Learning expertise and good understanding of search engines, to work on the following:
  • - Design, develop, and optimize semantic and vector-based search solutions leveraging Lucene/Solr and modern embeddings.
  • - Apply machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing techniques to improve search relevance and ranking.
  • - Develop scalable data pipelines and APIs for indexing, retrieval, and model inference.
  • - Integrate ML models and search capabilities into production systems.
  • - Evaluate, fine-tune, and monitor search performance metrics.
  • - Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and product teams to translate business needs into technical implementations.
  • - Stay current with advancements in search technologies, LLMs, and semantic retrieval frameworks.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering, with a focus on Information Retrieval or Semantic Search.
  • Strong programming experience in both Java and Python (production-level code, not just prototyping).
  • Deep knowledge of Lucene, Apache Solr, or Elasticsearch (indexing, query tuning, analyzers, scoring models).
  • Experience with Vector Databases, Embeddings, and Semantic Search techniques.
  • Strong understanding of NLP techniques (tokenization, embeddings, transformers, etc.).
  • Experience deploying and maintaining ML/search systems in production.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, version control, code review).


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Oracle Cloud Field Service consultant
description:
Job Specification: Oracle Cloud Field Service Consultant

Contract Role – Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Field Service (OFS) Consultant to support the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of our field service operations. This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Configure OFS modules including capacity, activity management, work order orchestration, routing plans, and mobility experiences.
  • Integrate OFS with other Oracle cloud applications, especially Oracle Service Cloud , Oracle CPQ , and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring seamless field operations.
  • Recommend best practices and continuous improvements in field service processes.
  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience with Oracle CPQ (quoting workflows, commerce rules, integrations).
  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).

title: Training Coordinator
description:
About NIIT


NIIT is a leading Skills and Talent Development Corporation that is building a manpower pool for global industry requirements. The company, which was set up in 1981 to help the nascent IT industry overcome its human resource challenges, today ranks among the world’s leading training companies owing to its vast, yet comprehensive array of talent development programs. With a footprint across 40 nations, NIIT offers training and development solutions to Individuals, Enterprises, and Institutions.


Link to our LinkedIn Page -

Link to our website -

Position: Training Coordinator


We are looking for our next training operations coordinator. This role is part of the Operations team and supports NIIT’s customer(s) in Frankfurt.

to deliver outstanding service.

We all work together on a common project with part of the team based in India.

As a training operations coordinator, you will be reporting to the training operations manager.

You will be the key contact point for all local stakeholders, coordinating training session delivery. You will master and oversee all activities within the service.

You will work closely and in partnership with the customer’s learning delivery team.


Roles & Responsibility:


  • Analyze the training needs provided by the Client and determine the number of sessions needed to train the overall number of trainees according to courses and per site,
  • Initiate and manage requests for session creation, modification, completion, and cancellation where required,
  • Organize the training sessions according to trainees’ expectations and availability and ensure their proper execution,
  • Calibrate and coordinate with the Indian team for any changes/updates in the training event/program,
  • Support completion of training activities by following up for attendance and invoice if required,
  • Follow and ensure adherence to the workflow and processes using the CRM tool
  • Ensure Learner Support Level 2


Experience & Skill:


  • 2 to 4 years of experience in learning delivery management and/or operations,
  • Exposure to an international work environment
  • High-level understanding of the training landscape
  • Customer service-oriented posture is a must
  • Team player
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concise thoughts
  • Attention to detail, structured and organized, capable of prioritizing activities
  • Knowledge of Salesforce or any other CRM
  • Knowledge of Cornerstone or any other LMS is an added advantage
  • Fluent in English is a mandatory requirement
  • Proficient in MS Office, Excel, SharePoint


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Especialista Salesforce
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Especialista Salesforce


Responsabilidades:

Perfil de liderança

Desenvolver soluções customizadas na plataforma Salesforce utilizando Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), Visualforce e triggers.

Implementar integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST/SOAP.

Criar automações avançadas, componentes reutilizáveis e testes unitários com alta cobertura.

Otimizar queries e gerenciar limites da plataforma (governor limits).

Colaborar com times funcionais e administradores para entrega de soluções técnicas aderentes aos requisitos de negócio.

Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (DevOps), incluindo controle de versões e deploys com ferramentas como SFDX, Git e pipelines de CI/CD


Requisitos:

Domínio de todas as etapas do ciclo no Salesforce

Experiência prévia em projetos Salesforce (atuando como desenvolvedor).

Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e em squads multidisciplinares.

Experiência prática com integrações complexas e grandes volumes de dados.


Desejável experiência em projetos de implementação de soluções escaláveis em empresas de médio e grande porte.



Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto

CLT

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão flash

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Frontend - Sênior
description:
Esperamos que você:

  • Traduza necessidades de produto e design em entregas técnicas escaláveis e bem estruturadas;
  • Garanta excelência técnica nos componentes, fluxos de publicação e documentação, mantendo alta qualidade, performance e usabilidade;
  • Promova cultura de boas práticas de engenharia, acessibilidade e inner-source.


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar com migração da stack de CSS-in-JS, otimização de performance e SSR, manutenção e organização de monorepo, estruturação de bundling, CI/CD e publicação de pacotes;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com pessoas de Produto, Design, Dados e Engenharia, promovendo alinhamento e entregas integradas;
  • Contribuir para uma documentação clara, acessível e de fácil uso por outros squads.


Requisitos

  • Proficiência com TypeScript e React;
  • Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);
  • Vivência com monorepos (ex: Lerna, Nx, Turborepo);
  • Experiência com testes unitários e end-to-end;
  • Conhecimento em acessibilidade Web (padrões WCAG).


Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Experiência em atuar com Design System e Design Tokens;
  • Vivência em migração de ferramentas CSS-in-JS;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, Chromatic);
  • Implementação e manutenção de Storybook;
  • Testes de regressão visual;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou iniciativas internas de melhoria contínua.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente desafiador com impacto real em produtos utilizados por milhões de pessoas;
  • Colaboração direta com designers, devs e líderes técnicos altamente capacitados;
  • Cultura de engenharia baseada em aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e excelência.


Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of professional full stack software development experience to join our U.K. / U.S. client. You will help build the foundation of the client's back-end and data systems. The role will focus on platform development using Supabase, TypeScript, and modern web frameworks, enabling robust data pipelines, operations automation, and API integrations that support the client's growing applications.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and extend back-end systems using Supabase, leveraging database, auth, and edge function capabilities
  • Develop and maintain TypeScript-based APIs and integrations that underpin the client's platform and data services
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to deliver end-to-end features and performant, user-facing experiences
  • Contribute to the evolution of the client's internal automation tools and data pipeline implementations
  • Work closely with product, data, and AI teams on new integrations from analytics and forecasting to blockchain-enabled features
  • Ensure reliability, performance, and scalability while maintaining lightweight, maintainable systems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Position: Data Engineer

Location: Remote in Brazil

Duration: 3 year+ PJ Contract

Monthly Salary Range: 3-5k USD/Month


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Hands on data engineering experience with Microsoft Fabric (highly preferred) or Azure Synapse/Databricks are also acceptable
  • Advanced Data Manipulation experience using SQL, Pandas, and PySpark
  • Proficiency in Azure Data Services such as: Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, or Azure SQL Databases


Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to Azure AI Services (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence).
  • Experience in Data Science & Machine Learning:
  • Python, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, MLFlow, EDA.
  • Familiarity with LLMs and related frameworks:
  • OpenAI, Prompt Engineering, LangChain.


Day to day –

We are seeking 2 experienced Data Engineers to support a large-scale ERP implementation for one of our hardware manufacturing clients. The ideal candidate will design, build, and optimize data pipelines and architectures to ensure seamless integration and transformation of enterprise data. This role requires strong technical expertise in modern data platforms, Azure services, and data modeling principles.


Key Duties and Responsibilities –

  • Design and implement scalable data pipelines for ERP integration.
  • Develop and maintain data models aligned with ERP requirements.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval using Azure services.
  • Collaborate with ERP functional teams to ensure accurate data migration and transformation.
  • Implement best practices for Data Architecture, Data Warehouse design, and Master Data Management.
  • Support Azure infrastructure and troubleshoot data-related issues.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards.

title: Analista de Sistemas Sênior – Suporte a Aplicações
description:
Analista de Sistemas Sênior – Suporte a Aplicações


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Sistemas Sênior para atuar remotamente em uma equipe global de suporte técnico, com foco em soluções de transferência gerenciada de arquivos (MFT – Globalscape EFT) e plataformas de serviços de conteúdo (CSP). Essa posição é estratégica para garantir a estabilidade, segurança e desempenho de aplicações corporativas utilizadas em diversos países.


✨ Principais Responsabilidades


  • Atuar no suporte técnico Nível 2 e 3 para sistemas MFT e CSP em ambientes globais.
  • Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em colaboração com times de Engenharia, DevOps e Infraestrutura.
  • Participar de chamadas de incidentes críticos como especialista em MFT e soluções digitais.
  • Documentar procedimentos de instalação, configuração e operação.
  • Monitorar desempenho de aplicações com ferramentas como Splunk e Datadog.
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz (RCA) e propor soluções definitivas.
  • Colaborar com áreas de produto, vendas e implementação para onboarding de clientes.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e melhorias de processos.

title: Solution Architect (Snowflake)
description:
Exadel is seeking a Solution Architect with Snowflake to work remote as an Independent contractor for a Global client (A U.S.-based education services provider). English is mandatory because this professional will have to report abroad. And design and architect end-to-end data solutions leveraging Snowflake as the primary cloud data platform.



Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain Medallion architecture in Snowflake, ensuring a robust dimensional data model for the gold layer.
  • Define and oversee data transformation processes using Coalesce.io, and manage data extraction and loading with Airbyte.
  • Integrate and modernize legacy data systems built on SQL Server/SSIS, with limited use of Azure Data Factory where required.
  • Design and optimize the BI semantic layer to enable self-service analytics in Power BI.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable data architecture solutions.
  • Establish best practices for data modeling, pipeline development, and version control using GitHub.
  • Track project progress and deliverables through Jira.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Project team.



Qualifications


  • Proven experience as a Data Architect or Solution Architect with a strong background in cloud-based data platforms.



Required Skills


  • Hands-on expertise with Snowflake, Power BI, Coalesce.io, Airbyte, SQL Server/SSIS, and some exposure to Azure Data Factory.
  • Deep understanding of Medallion architecture and dimensional data modeling.
  • Strong knowledge of designing and maintaining BI semantic models for self-service analytics.
  • Experience establishing and enforcing data engineering standards, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Familiarity with Jira for project management and GitHub for version control.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across both business and technical teams.
  • Minimum 4-hour overlap with US Eastern Time.



Preferred Skills


  • Exposure to Salesforce integration and data sources.
  • Experience in the higher education (higher ed) or ed-tech domain.

  • Experience establishing and enforcing data engineering standards, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Familiarity with Jira for project management and GitHub for version control.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across both business and technical teams.
  • Minimum 4-hour overlap with US Eastern Time.



Preferred Skills


  • Exposure to Salesforce integration and data sources.
  • Experience in the higher education (higher ed) or ed-tech domain.

title: PS Systems Engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

title: Python Developer - SR/PL
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home



Job Summary

As a Python Developer, it is expected that the ideal candidate understands a broad range of computer science concepts and their applicability. This person can dive deeply into a wide range of technical problems, offering suggestions and feedback to their team and can also help to understand the requirements, and translate to an architectural design and help to plan and implement this solution for those requirements.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Actively support the development teams;
  • Mentor less experienced team members;
  • Drive team to innovate and deliver roadmap features with agility and high quality;
  • Digest requirements from product team and work on solutions with performance and scalability features for cloud systems;
  • Development of new features;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches by elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Participation in the complete cycle of development from requirements gathering, development, and testing;
  • Participation in technical discussions with customers;
  • Perform code reviews;
  • Conduct yourself as a trusted technical advisor;
  • Follow agile processes and participate actively in all development phases.


Essential Skills

  • Experience leading development teams;
  • Proficiency with development in Python versions 2 and 3;
  • Experience with pyTest;
  • Experience with Linux environments, CLI commands, Shell Script and logs;
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Jenkins;
  • Experience with GIT;
  • Experience with Github, GIT, code;
  • Knowledge of Agile development (e.g. using Scrum, Kanban, etc.).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • NETCONF/YANG.



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Java Senior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Se você é um(a) desenvolvedor(a) Java experiente, com mais de 5 anos de prática e conhecimento em Java 8+, esta vaga pode ser ideal para você. Valorizamos profissionais que tenham habilidades técnicas sólidas e estejam comprometidos com o crescimento contínuo. Buscamos pessoas que reconheçam a importância da colaboração e da busca por respostas com colegas. Se você se identifica com esses valores e está preparado para desafios estimulantes, inscreva-se. Estamos ansiosos para receber sua inscrição!



Nosso ambiente de trabalho:

  • Trabalhamos com metodologias ágeis
  • Infraestrutura na AWS
  • Integração contínua com Jenkins, Sonar e Docker
  • Repositórios no GitHub
  • Intellij IDE (Ultimate)
  • Linux (remotamente) e Mac (no escritório)


Desafios que você vai encontrar:

  • Processamento de milhões de registros em curto espaço de tempo
  • Consulta massiva de dados para alta performance
  • Processamento assíncrono de jobs
  • Ambiente de alta concorrência
  • Tunning de funcionalidades do sistema
  • Uso de ferramentas de análise de código e profiling
  • Manutenção de base de código extensa
  • Realizar tudo isso sem quebrar o que já existe


O que você vai usar no dia-a-dia:

  • Java 21
  • Spring MVC
  • Spring Boot
  • VueJS
  • TypeScript
  • Javascript
  • Hibernate
  • Git
  • Oracle e PostgreSQL
  • JUnit 5
  • Mockito 2
  • Redis
  • Selenide
  • Desenvolver APIs utilizando Java e outras tecnologias listadas abaixo.


O que você vai usar ocasionalmente:

  • PL/SQL
  • MongoDB 4.4
  • Ionic com VueJS (Desenvolvimento Mobile)


O que você pode precisar para dar manutenção:

  • JSP
  • Angular JS
  • jQuery


Conhecimentos desejáveis:

  • VueJs
  • Experiência com troubleshooting e análise de logs e performance
  • Otimização de SQLs
  • Kibana/APM

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We’re Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Our engineers work on high-traffic, mission-critical systems that power millions of users across the globe.

We believe in autonomy, ownership, and solving hard problems — at scale. If you’re passionate about infrastructure done right, we want you on the team.



What You’ll Do:

  • Design and deploy cloud-native systems on AWS , that just work — at scale.
  • Own Kubernetes clusters : architecture, automation, observability, and performance tuning.
  • Build Terraform modules and GitOps pipelines to make deployments boring (in a good way).
  • Create CI/CD pipelines that are fast, reliable, and get new features into production safely.
  • Automate everything — provisioning, monitoring, security — with the best tools for the job.
  • Push systems to 99.99% uptime across billions of transactions a year.
  • Partner directly with product engineers, security, and leadership to ship infrastructure that accelerates growth.
  • Mentor teammates, review pull requests, and help define best practices as we scale.

You Should Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps , Cloud Engineering , or Site Reliability Engineering .
  • Strong Proven track record with LAMP (Linux Apache Mysql PHP)
  • Strong real-world experience with AWS , Kubernetes , and Terraform .
  • A deep understanding of Linux, containers, networking, and cloud-native security.
  • Proven ability to scale systems to handle high-volume , high-availability workloads.
  • Hands-on skills in scripting or coding — Python , Go , or Bash are all great.
  • An eye for automation and eliminating manual work wherever you find it.
  • Startup or growth-stage experience (bonus points).
  • Excellent async communication skills (Slack, GitHub, Docs).


Bonus Points If You’ve:

  • Built infrastructure for AI/ML systems, SaaS, or telco-scale apps.
  • Used tools like GitHub Actions , ArgoCD , Vault , Elastic Stack , or EKS .
  • Led technical teams or been a mentor for junior engineers.
  • Got certifications like AWS Solutions Architect, CKA, or Azure Admin.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno
description:
Missão da área

A área de Desenvolvimento transforma a visão estratégica da Serena em projetos reais, garantindo um pipeline robusto e sustentável. Atua como dona na alocação de capital, buscando excelência, questionando limites e convertendo oportunidades em ativos sólidos. Mantém o cliente no centro das decisões, antecipando riscos e resolvendo problemas relevantes do setor de energia com integridade e ética. A tecnologia é pilar essencial, usando dados, ferramentas digitais e IA para acelerar análises, qualificar decisões e impulsionar inovação. Incorporando soluções tecnológicas, simplifica processos e amplia a capacidade da Serena de gerar valor em um setor em constante evolução.


⚡Principais Responsabilidades

  • Originação e Estruturação de Projetos Mapear oportunidades de novos projetos, mercados e clusters. Realizar triagens iniciais, avaliando viabilidade técnica, regulatória e comercial;
  • Estruturar análises de viabilidade de forma crítica, organizada e consistente;
  • Gestão de Licenciamento e Regulação Acompanhar processos de licenciamento, autorizações e pareceres. Interagir com áreas regulatórias para garantir alinhamento técnico e prazos;
  • Antecipar riscos e sugerir caminhos preventivos;
  • Coordenação e Mobilização da Rede Engajar áreas internas (regulação, jurídico, engenharia, energia, mercado) para destravar temas;
  • Garantir clareza sobre o que cada área precisa entregar e quando;
  • Manter comunicação simples, direta e estruturada para evitar retrabalhos;
  • Preparação de Materiais de Decisão Elaborar apresentações, notas e análises executivas para comitês;
  • Sintetizar informações complexas de forma clara, lógica e orientada à tomada de decisão;
  • Destacar riscos, opções, premissas e recomendações;


Requisitos da Vaga

  • Formação completa em Engenharia;
  • 1–3 anos em desenvolvimento de projetos de energia renovável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de acesso (ONS/ANEEL), normativos do setor elétrico, fundiário, licenciamento ambiental, contratos e análises de recurso;
  • Conhecimento em Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI;
  • Inglês: Fluente.

Diferenciais: programação, MS Project, conhecimento adicional em GIS/QGIS



Soft Skills Desejadas

  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas frentes simultâneas
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva
  • Atenção a detalhes
  • Organização
  • Perfil analítico
  • Proatividade e autonomia
  • Senso de dono e gestão de prazos
  • Resiliência para ambientes complexos

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack SR (Java / Angular)
description:
A T-Systems , multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca Software Engineer com bom nível de idioma inglês (desejável alemão) , para atuar de forma 100% remota, em projetos internacionais.


Como profissional Fullstack você irá:


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento ágil de novas funcionalidades, em parceria com o time da Alemanha (líderes de projeto e arquitetos de software).
  • Fazer parte de um time brasileiro em crescimento , responsável pelo ciclo completo de desenvolvimento em ambiente DevOps , contribuindo para a evolução contínua de uma plataforma estratégica e global.


O que buscamos:


  • Proficiência em Java e/ou Angular;
  • Experiência com Kafka ;
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em Apache Flink , OPC-UA e MQTT;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban etc.);
  • Bom nível de idioma inglês e/ou alemão .


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.


Você atuará em um projeto global, com tecnologias modernas, metodologias ágeis e interação direta com um dos maiores grupos automotivos do mundo.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, colaboração e desafios internacionais, essa é a sua chance de acelerar sua carreira!

title: Programador Ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa: OniLearning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, OniLearning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de OniLearning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.


Qualificações:

  • Desenvolvimento em Ruby: Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
  • Design de Software: Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.

A ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!

title: AML/CFT Compliance Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance AML/CFT and sanctions policies in alignment with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Act as a primary compliance interface with regulators, including managing inspections, responding to inquiries, and executing remediation plans.
  • Perform risk-based customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews for both individuals and corporate clients.
  • Support ongoing monitoring activities, including transaction surveillance, sanctions screening, and the investigation of alerts or potentially suspicious behaviors.
  • Prepare, review, and submit Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other mandatory filings to COAF or relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Track legislative and regulatory developments related to AML/CFT and sanctions, and drive timely updates to internal policies and procedures.
  • Assist in delivering internal training programs to strengthen organizational awareness of AML/CFT and sanctions compliance obligations.
  • Conduct periodic AML/CFT risk assessments to validate control effectiveness and ensure alignment with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, audit trails, and recordkeeping for all compliance assessments, escalations, investigations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits as well as regulatory reviews, ensuring timely and accurate provision of information.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to enhance compliance systems, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and oversight of third-party service providers supporting AML/CFT and broader compliance functions.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience within financial services, fintech, or virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense , with sound judgment in escalation and decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of COAF, the Central Bank of Brazil, CVM regulations, and FATF recommendations.
  • Hands-on expertise in KYC/KYB processes, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related field; postgraduate studies or professional certifications (CAMS, ICA, etc.) strongly preferred.
  • Excellent analytical abilities, high ethical standards, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must satisfy all fit-and-proper requirements, including:
  • No history of bankruptcy or insolvency;
  • An impeccable professional reputation;
  • Strong understanding of the crypto industry, including market dynamics and associated risks;
  • Technical competence aligned with the responsibilities of the role.

  • Track legislative and regulatory developments related to AML/CFT and sanctions, and drive timely updates to internal policies and procedures.
  • Assist in delivering internal training programs to strengthen organizational awareness of AML/CFT and sanctions compliance obligations.
  • Conduct periodic AML/CFT risk assessments to validate control effectiveness and ensure alignment with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, audit trails, and recordkeeping for all compliance assessments, escalations, investigations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits as well as regulatory reviews, ensuring timely and accurate provision of information.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to enhance compliance systems, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and oversight of third-party service providers supporting AML/CFT and broader compliance functions.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience within financial services, fintech, or virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense , with sound judgment in escalation and decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of COAF, the Central Bank of Brazil, CVM regulations, and FATF recommendations.

  • Must satisfy all fit-and-proper requirements, including:
  • No history of bankruptcy or insolvency;
  • An impeccable professional reputation;
  • Strong understanding of the crypto industry, including market dynamics and associated risks;
  • Technical competence aligned with the responsibilities of the role.

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: GCP Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for GCP Data Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Proficiency in BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub

Experience with SQL, Oracle Database, and PostgreSQL

Knowledge of orchestration using Cloud Composer (Airflow)

Hands-on experience with CI/CD applied to data pipelines (Git, Terraform)

Experience with cloud cost and performance optimization

GCP certifications

Knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE) and APIs on GCP

Experience with Machine Learning pipelines (Vertex AI, AI Platform)

Previous involvement with Data Mesh and distributed architectures

Understanding of Data Lake layers

Knowledge of batch and streaming processing

Experience with data modeling (relational, dimensional, and NoSQL)

Design and implement data architectures on GCP using services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer, among others.

Develop and optimize scalable, high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines.

Ensure data quality, integrity, and security end-to-end.

Create and maintain data models aligned with business needs.

Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases.

Automate ingestion, transformation, and data delivery processes.

Monitor and optimize cost and performance of GCP resources.

Implement best practices for DataOps and Data Governance.


BigQuery, Dataflow, AlloyDB, APIGee (focus in GCP)

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Editor de vídeos curtos (shorts / Reels / TikTok)
description:
A MLPro está buscando um editor de vídeos freelancer para nos apoiar na criação de shorts para YouTube, Reels e TikTok , a partir de vídeos longos já gravados.


Nosso conteúdo é técnico/educacional , focado em Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Project, PMO e gestão de projetos, para serem publicados nas nossas redes sociais e Youtube (@MLProPPM).


Responsabilidades:

  • Cortar trechos de vídeos longos para criar shorts de até 40–60 segundos .
  • Adaptar do formato horizontal para vertical (9:16), mantendo bom enquadramento.
  • Inserir legendas dinâmicas , com destaque em palavras-chave, sem erros de português.
  • Seguir a identidade visual da MLPro  (cores, logo e estilo mais sóbrio, não infantil).
  • Entregar arquivos em alta qualidade, prontos para publicação nas redes.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com edição de vídeos curtos para redes sociais (shorts, Reels, TikTok).
  • Portfólio específico de shorts/ vídeos curtos  já publicados.
  • Atenção a detalhes de áudio, texto e ritmo de edição.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com conteúdo técnico/educacional.

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Vaga 100% remota, formato freelancer.
  • Pacote inicial mensal de vídeos curtos, com possibilidade de expansão conforme resultados.


Na candidatura pelo LinkedIn, anexe seu portfólio de vídeos curtos  (documento com links dos vídeos) no campo de currículo (CV) . Candidaturas sem portfólio de vídeos curtos  não serão consideradas.

Nosso conteúdo é técnico/educacional , focado em Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Project, PMO e gestão de projetos, para serem publicados nas nossas redes sociais e Youtube (@MLProPPM).


Responsabilidades:

  • Cortar trechos de vídeos longos para criar shorts de até 40–60 segundos .
  • Adaptar do formato horizontal para vertical (9:16), mantendo bom enquadramento.
  • Inserir legendas dinâmicas , com destaque em palavras-chave, sem erros de português.
  • Seguir a identidade visual da MLPro  (cores, logo e estilo mais sóbrio, não infantil).
  • Entregar arquivos em alta qualidade, prontos para publicação nas redes.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com edição de vídeos curtos para redes sociais (shorts, Reels, TikTok).
  • Portfólio específico de shorts/ vídeos curtos  já publicados.
  • Atenção a detalhes de áudio, texto e ritmo de edição.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com conteúdo técnico/educacional.

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Vaga 100% remota, formato freelancer.
  • Pacote inicial mensal de vídeos curtos, com possibilidade de expansão conforme resultados.


Na candidatura pelo LinkedIn, anexe seu portfólio de vídeos curtos  (documento com links dos vídeos) no campo de currículo (CV) . Candidaturas sem portfólio de vídeos curtos  não serão consideradas.

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Accounting & Administrative Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly capable Accountant to support the financial operations of MoveUp across multiple entities.


In this role, you will ensure the smooth running of daily accounting activities, reinforce financial controls, and provide essential backup across all key operational processes.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and reliability in our financial workflows.


Specifically, your role will involve:


Customer Billing & Receivables


  • Create, validate, and issue customer invoices
  • Manage invoicing workflows
  • Monitor incoming payments and perform payment matching
  • Execute customer reminders and maintain updated follow-up tracking
  • Maintain customer reporting and ensure accuracy of receivables data


Supplier Accounting & Payables


  • Verify and validate supplier invoices
  • Ensure correct accounting allocation of supplier expenses
  • Support the monthly payables closing process


Bank Reconciliation & Treasury Support


  • Perform reconciliations for multi-currency accounts
  • Assist with treasury tracking and cash flow updates


General Accounting & Reporting


  • Support the bookkeeping
  • Maintain and control analytical entries
  • Participate in quarterly closings
  • Ensure compliance with internal financial processes


Cross-Entity Support & Process Improvements


  • Contribute to standardizing accounting processes across the group
  • Participate in internal projects workflow optimization, workflow automation, reporting enhancement
  • Improve documentation and build a finance operational manual


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting
  • Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial workflows
  • Experience with Odoo is a plus
  • Solid Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Ability to work across multiple entities and currencies
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and autonomy
  • English required; Portuguese or French is a plus
  • Experience with international accounting environments is appreciated


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next Steps in the Process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for You


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media
